title: DyCelFEM: dynamic finite-element modelling of multiscale cell dynamics
description:
DyCelFEM simulates skin wound healing by coupling a deformable finite-element representation of individual cells to SBML-encoded intracellular reaction networks and inter-cell cytokine diffusion. Cell mechanics, growth, division, apoptosis and chemotactic migration are driven by the molecular state of each cell, so tissue-scale healing dynamics emerge from subcellular signalling.

This is the simulation code accompanying Cao et al., Spatio-temporal multiscale cell modeling of skin wound healing, Biophysical Journal (2026), doi:10.1016/j.bpj.2026.03.021.
